title: Show an Admin field only when it is relevant
description: Use a serializable Admin condition to reveal a field from the editor's current form values.
problem: Some fields only make sense after an editor has made an earlier choice.
summary: Use an Admin condition to hide irrelevant fields until the current form state makes them useful.
runtimeNotes: Uses a serializable Jexl Admin condition that is valid in both runtimes.
intents: show discount only with a coupon
make the admin form react to another field
